producer_report.summary: `athena --version` now prints the package version, the source commit and a dirty marker, built from build_info(). Running `cargo run -p athena-cli -- --version` with no build env exits 0 and prints `athena 0.1.0 (commit unknown, dirty)`. I added `wiring::version_string(&Build)`. main.rs builds the clap command at runtime with that string, and I removed the derive's `version` attribute. I did not run the full `cargo test --locked`.

checks_run.note: I ran this without `--check`, so it applied formatting. I did not run `cargo fmt --all --check` afterwards.
4 tests passed: clean, dirty, unknown, and the binary's output.
Only the new version test target ran.

open_issues: The xtask change is only a comment saying the two env vars feed `--version`. xtask needed no functional change.
The README example shows the shape as `athena 0.1.0 (commit 0123abc…, dirty)`. xtask embeds the full 40-character hash, so a real installed binary prints the full hash, not a short one.
learnings: The `athena` main() parses arguments with `Cli::parse()`. Git-hook invocations are detected by binary name before that.
Clap's `version` needs a `&'static str`, so I leaked the string once at startup with `Box::leak`.
